final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM department_counts) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share
